Indonesia Forest Fires Cause Haze, School Closures in Malaysia

Toxic haze originating from Indonesia's forest fires has led to school closures in Malaysia, with landmarks in Singapore becoming obscured. The BBC's Tessa Wong reported that one of Indonesia's most severe wildfire seasons is affecting countries across Southeast Asia. Malaysian Prime Minister stated that Indonesia has agreed to implement measures to address the haze.
